title: A derived class
description:
`Animal` is provided. Write a class `Dog` that **inherits** from it (`class Dog : public Animal`):

- its constructor takes a name and passes it up to `Animal`'s constructor in the initializer list;
- it adds one member function of its own, `std::string fetch() const`, returning for example `"Rex fetches!"`.

Everything public in `Animal` (here, `name()` and `eat()`) is automatically available on a `Dog` too.
hints: `m_name` is private to `Animal`, so `Dog` cannot touch it directly. Use the public `name()` instead.
